definitions.short: to glitter , i.e. be golden in color
definitions.full: H6668. tsaheb or tsahob [ צָהֹב צָהֵב, , compare Lag BN 31 ] verb gleam (Late Hebrew id. (of face, bronze, etc.); Arabic be red ); — Hoph`al Participle מֻצְהָב נְחשֶׁת Ezra 8:27 polished bronze (so Late Hebrew and-apparently Hebraism - ᵑ7 2Chr 4:16 ).
